# Integration Test Fixtures

This directory contains test fixture projects used for A.I.R.A. integration tests.

## Fixtures

1. `passing_project`: A standard Python project using `pytest` where all tests pass.
2. `failing_test_project`: A project using `pytest` with an intentional bug causing one test to fail.
3. `security_issue_project`: A project containing a deliberate command injection vulnerability.
4. `custom_tests_project`: A project with source code but no tests (tests are meant to be provided separately).
5. `unittest_project`: A project using the standard library `unittest` framework instead of `pytest`.
